title: C. Minimum on Subarrays
statement:
There is a variable $$sum$$, which is initially equal to $$0$$.

There is also a data structure that can perform the following operations:

The operations popback , popfront , and min cannot be applied to an empty structure!

Using this structure, you would like to be able to find the sum of the minimums of all non-empty subarrays of an array $$a$$ of $$n$$ elements.

More formally, your task is to find a sequence of no more than $$n $\cdot (n + 2)$$$ commands such that after all operations, the variable $$sum$$ will be equal to $$\sum_{0 $\leq l \leq r  \lt  n} \min(a[l],\dots, a[r])$$$ for any possible array $$a$$.

The first line contains a single integer $$n$$ ($$1 $\leq n \leq 500$$$) — the number of elements in the array.

Output $$k$$ ($$1 $\leq k \leq n \cdot (n + 2)$$$) commands. Each command must be one of the following five lines:

If there are multiple valid answers, output any.
input: Input The first line contains a single integer $$n$$ ($$1 $\leq n \leq 500$$$) — the number of elements in the array.
output: Output Output $$k$$ ($$1 $\leq k \leq n \cdot (n + 2)$$$) commands. Each command must be one of the following five lines: " pushback a[i] ", where $$i$$ — a number from $$0$$ to $$n - 1$$ " pushfront a[i] ", where $$i$$ — a number from $$0$$ to $$n - 1$$ " popback " " popfront " " min " If there are multiple valid answers, output any.
